question: Where should the practitioner proceed after praising and bowing to the Lord of gods?
premises: Praise and obeisance to the Lord of gods are completed.
The practitioner is instructed to resort to the place of fire offering.
inference: Therefore, the ritual sequence moves from worship and praise to the fire-offering site.
plain_english: Having praised and bowed to the Lord of gods, one should proceed to the place of the fire offering.
